title: Coraline
author: Neil Gaiman
summary: Bored in her family's new flat, a girl opens a small door and finds a copy of her home where everything is better and her other parents want her to stay. She soon learns what those button eyes are hiding.
readIf: you want a short, properly creepy children's story that adults enjoy too.
skipIf: you want a soft bedtime read, as it is genuinely unsettling for sensitive young readers.

pairings.reason: Same author, another story of a child up against something old and frightening, told by an adult remembering.
Another girl in a strange, upside-down world, with more nonsense and less menace.
A grown-up horror classic with the same sense that a house can be wrong.
